issues.issue: This is an interfund transfer (removed in the p6 Eliminations column against Extracurricular receipts), not instruction spending or a grant to another entity. It is also counted twice in detail: the Activity Fund's Extracurricular receipts 817,168 (detail[72], p13) include the 250,000. detail[72] has no review flag.

The General Fund pupil transportation figure includes the 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund, which shows up again as Depreciation 'Transfer from other funds' revenue (detail[69]) and as capital outlay. This is double counted in detail and has no review flag. The amount itself is correctly transcribed.

The budget schedule lists this under State receipts (code 3133), and other reports (e.g. Battle Creek) treat it as intergovernmental/other state aid. The same applies to detail[49] and detail[61] and to top-level receipts[8] (p5 shows it under Taxes, so the top-level choice is defensible).
